evals.name: pricing-card-row
evals.prompt: 在首页的 home__slot 里加一行定价卡片：基础版和专业版左右并排，各自带名称、价格和一行说明。
evals.expected_output: compile succeeds; `background` is an alias of `background-color`, so the four frames normalize `#fff`→`#ffffff` and `#111`→`#111111`; `margin:16px 0` and `margin:0` are kept, and no receipt entry names a margin property, because format-v3 §7 makes `margin` a member of CSS_ALLOWED; only the one-sided longhands are refused; `box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.06)` is one declaration with two commas inside and must not be split; the trailing `;` on home__pricing's style attribute is removed by the text layer; no data-id is generated because all nine already exist and are unique.

assertions.text: no receipt entry names a margin property: `margin:16px 0` on home__pricing and `margin:0` on the four text elements are kept in the file; no diagnostic code mentions a margin property either

each `background` declaration appears in the receipt as a normalized `background-color` value or as a style/ alias diagnostic naming both `background` and `background-color`; a declaration that is dropped with no receipt entry fails
`rgba(0,0,0,.06)` survives inside the box-shadow value on home__plan-basic — the receipt does not contain a declaration whose value ends at `rgba(0,0,0`

zero ids are auto-filled and the set of data-id values after compile equals exactly {home__pricing, home__plan-basic, home__plan-basic-name, home__plan-basic-price, home__plan-basic-note, home__plan-pro, home__plan-pro-name, home__plan-pro-price, home__plan-pro-note}

evals.name: hero

evals.expected_output: `background:linear-gradient(180deg,#111 0%,#333 100%)` hits the `background` alias and its value is not a colour, so the fragment is refused by a style/ bad-color diagnostic on home__hero whose message keeps the whole gradient string, and the file is not changed; `font:700 28px/1.2 sans-serif` and `font:400 14px/1.5 sans-serif` use the `font` shorthand, which is not a member of CSS_ALLOWED, but the compile stops at the refusal so this receipt gives them no verdict; `margin:0` on home__hero-title and home__hero-sub is legal, and no receipt entry names a margin property, because `margin` is a member of CSS_ALLOWED; `rgba(255,255,255,.72)` is never truncated at a comma.

assertions.text: the receipt refuses the fragment at home__hero with a style/ diagnostic that quotes the whole `linear-gradient(180deg,#111 0%,#333 100%)`, so no verdict is reported for the `font` shorthand on home__hero-title
the refusal message quotes the background value whole — `linear-gradient(180deg,#111 0%,#333 100%)` is not truncated at the first comma inside the parentheses
the file is not written at all, so home__hero's style attribute still ends with the `;` the snippet has
the colour on home__hero-sub is either preserved as `rgba(255,255,255,.72)`/`rgba(255,255,255,0.72)` or named in a style/ diagnostic; no declaration value ends mid-colour at `rgba(255,255,255`

the receipt accounts for the `background` declaration on home__settings-voice as either `background-color:#ffffff` or a style/ alias diagnostic naming `background`
exactly three data-id values exist after compile, all distinct, and none was auto-generated

evals.name: form-field
evals.prompt: 加一个手机号输入项：上面一行小标签，下面一条输入框。
evals.expected_output: `<label>` claims `data-type="text"` on a tag that TYPE_TAGS.text does not list, so the fragment is refused by one `structure/type-tag-mismatch` diagnostic on home__field-phone-label and the file is not changed: the parser preserves, the validator reports, the serializer never rewrites. The compiler must not delete them and must not invent a data-type for the `<input>`. The `<label>` additionally claims data-type="text" on a tag that is not in TYPE_TAGS.text.

assertions.text: the receipt contains exactly one `structure/type-tag-mismatch` diagnostic, on home__field-phone-label, naming the tag `label` and the declared type `text`; the `<input>` gets no diagnostic, because the compile stops at the label
after compile the text still contains the literal `<input` and the literal `placeholder="请输入手机号"` — the bytes survived byte for byte
the `<input>` element still has exactly its four original attributes (data-id, type, placeholder, style) and no `data-type` was added to it
the refusal does not also produce structure/missing-type or structure/duplicate-id diagnostics

Expected: `structure/duplicate-id` naming both, or the add verb refuses before writing and leaves the file untouched. The compiler must not silently rename one of them and must not pick a winner.

assertions.text: the receipt contains a `structure/duplicate-id` diagnostic for `home__stats`, or the add exits non-zero with a refusal that names `home__stats`
the report covers two distinct locations that are siblings under home__slot (the pre-existing group and the inserted group); a single-location report fails

no automatic rename is applied: the file contains exactly two `data-id="home__stats"` occurrences, not one `home__stats` plus one `home__stats-2`
